description: JSON-spec-driven flyer generator (Node stdlib), illustration library extracted from the existing 4 scenes/4 rewards, palettes, CLI, 4 example specs and node:test tests — regenerating the 4 reference flyers byte-for-byte (SVG and sips PNG). Skill root: /Users/makotosaito/bescon/.kiro/skills/bescon-flyer (abbrev SK). Sections 'Spec schema', 'Fit rules', 'Palettes', 'CLI', 'Illustration contract' of /Users/makotosaito/bescon/.agents/tasks/plan.md are authoritative. Must be done before FEAT-002.
steps: Copy /Users/makotosaito/bescon/.agents/flyer/lib.js and people.js verbatim to SK/scripts/lib.js and SK/scripts/people.js (people.js keeps require('./lib') — same dir, same instance).

Create SK/illustrations/scenes/{yamadera,zao,kaminoyama,ekimae}.js from .agents/flyer/scene_*.js: module.exports = { meta: { id, title (Japanese short description from the file's first comment), season: '晩秋', trail: <the trail string from data.js for that flyer> }, render(ctx) { const L = ctx.L; const { ...same destructuring... } = L; const { sideFigure|backFigure } = ctx.people; ...original body unchanged... } }. Keep module-level constants (MAPLE etc.). No require of lib/people inside snippets.

Create SK/illustrations/rewards/_parts.js exporting (L) => ({ table, vignette, beer }) with bodies copied from food.js, and SK/illustrations/rewards/{soba,pizza,wine,beef}.js each { meta: { id, title }, render(ctx) } where ctx.L is lib and ctx.parts = require('./_parts')(ctx.L) is provided by the generator (generator builds parts, snippet does not require). Keep rng seeds (5, 8, 21, 33) and call order identical.

Create SK/scripts/fit.js: tw(s,size) identical to build.js; fitSize(text, size, min, limit) returns largest size (step 0.5, emitted via f()) ≤ default whose tw fits, or null; wrapLines(text, size, limit, maxLines) honoring '|' forced breaks, else break preferring after ・、。）／, never starting a line with 、。）・ー, returns lines or null. Return the default size unchanged when it already fits (byte identity).

Create SK/scripts/spec.js: loadSpec(path) (JSON.parse; strip keys starting with '_' recursively), validate required keys per plan.md schema (exit-1-style errors with field names), derive: weekday via new Date(Date.UTC(y,m-1,d)).getUTCDay() → ['日','月','火','水','木','金','土'] and ['SUN','MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT']; 日時 row value `${y}年${m}月${d}日（${wdJ}）${start}集合` (m,d unpadded) unless overview.date.value given (then it must contain `（${wdJ}）` else error); header year, `MM.DD` zero-padded, `${WD}  ${start} START` (two spaces); round default 1 → `第${round}回 ベスコングルメ部`, `Vol.${String(round).padStart(2,'0')}`; kcal = explicit kcal or Math.round(mets*60*hours*1.05/50)*50 → String; theme id resolved from SK/assets/palettes.json or object with all 6 keys; edition gets '編' appended if missing; output_name default 'BCG企画_'+edition; footer `幹事：${organizer||'部長'}　／　${contact||'参加可否はこちらまで'}`; resolve illustration.scene/reward: bare id → SK/illustrations/{scenes,rewards}/<id>.js, else path ending .js resolved relative to the spec file dir (absolute allowed); trail = illustration.trail || scene.meta.trail; apply fit rules from plan.md and collect overflow errors (exit 3).

Create SK/scripts/layout.js: renderFlyer(norm) — port build() from .agents/flyer/build.js statement-by-statement (shadowRect, card, flame, iconShoe, iconSpark, iconCheers, header, concept, hero, trail, kcal, overview rows, notes, timeline, footer), replacing cfg literals with normalized fields and literal font sizes with the fitted sizes (default values identical to today's literals). Call order: resetDefs(); scene.render(ctx); reward.render(ctx); then layout. Opening tag: `<svg xmlns=... font-family="${JP}"><title>${esc(output_name)}</title>\n  <defs>` exactly matching the references. Explicit x/y on every <text> line; never dy.

Create SK/scripts/build.js CLI per plan.md 'CLI': `<spec.json> [--out dir] [--png] [--force]`, `--themes [dir]` (scan BCG企画_*.svg for the 900x6 top-bar fill and map to palette ids, print 未使用 for free ones), `--list`. Refuse to overwrite existing outputs without --force (exit 4). PNG via child_process.execFileSync('sips', ['-s','format','png', svg, '--out', png]). Print derived summary (weekday, 日時, kcal formula, any fitted sizes/wraps). Exit codes 0/1/3/4. Header comment in Japanese with usage.
Create SK/scripts/texts.js: prints the decoded inner text of every <text> element of an SVG, one per line, in document order (regex-based, unescape & < >).
Create SK/assets/palettes.json with the 8 palettes from plan.md (kaki/ai/budou/tokiwa copied exactly from data.js pal objects; yamabuki/seiji/enji/sumi as listed), each with name_ja.

Generate SK/examples/{yamadera,zao,kaminoyama,ekimae}.json with a throwaway node script in /tmp/bescon-skill-test that require()s /Users/makotosaito/bescon/.agents/flyer/data.js in place (require is read-only and safe; never run .agents/flyer/build.js in place) and maps fields: edition, round 1, area_romaji (place), date 2026-11-14, start 9:30, subtitle, theme id, kcal_basis (山寺 {mets:8.0,hours:1.2,activity:'石段登山'}, 蔵王 {6.0,1.5,'高原ハイク'}, 上山 {3.5,1.5,'城下町ウォーク'}, 駅前 {5.0,1.25,'ウォーク／ジョグ'}), overview.{place,exercise,meal,items} with value/note (from rows[1..4] value/sub), notes, caution (蔵王 true), timeline [{time,label}], illustration {scene, reward} (no trail, no date value). Add a `_comment` key. Pretty-print with 2-space indent, UTF-8.

Write SK/tests/fit.test.js (tw, fitSize no-op when fits, wrap with '|' and auto-wrap, kinsoku), SK/tests/spec.test.js (weekday for 2026-11-14 = 土/SAT and 2027-02-13 = 土/SAT, wrong weekday override rejected, kcal rounding for the 4 bases → 600/550/350/400, theme id resolution, '編' append, '_' keys ignored, overflow → error), SK/tests/identity.test.js (for each example, render in-memory and compare to the workspace-root BCG企画_*編.svg string; skip if the original is absent). Use node:test + node:assert only.

Stress check: write /tmp/bescon-skill-test/stress.json (10-char edition e.g. 'かみのやま温泉さんぽ編', long place value with note, one long notes string, timeline of 6 items with no '|', reuse kaminoyama/wine) → build --png must exit 0; view the PNG with read_file and confirm nothing overlaps/clips. Write /tmp/bescon-skill-test/overflow.json with an absurdly long overview value → must exit 3 and write no file.

CLI (final): `node SK/scripts/build.js <spec.json> [--out <dir>] [--png] [--force]` (out default cwd, created if missing; refuses existing svg (and png when --png) without --force → exit 4, nothing written); `--themes [dir]` (default cwd; prints `id name_ja main 使用中: <編>` or `未使用`, plus `その他:` for flyers whose top-bar color matches no palette); `--list` (scenes then rewards, id + meta.title (+season)); `-h/--help`. Exit codes 0 ok / 1 spec-usage error (also sips failure) / 3 overflow (nothing written) / 4 exists. Errors print a bullet list naming fields (Japanese). Success prints: wrote paths, 曜日, 日時, ヘッダー (year / MM.DD / startLine / Vol · AREA / 第N回), 消費カロリー formula `M METs × 60kg × Hh × 1.05 = raw → N kcal（50単位で四捨五入・activity）` or `（kcal 直接指定）`, テーマ, イラスト paths, 自動調整 list (`field: 62px → 56px` or `13.5px のまま、自動改行「a / b」`) or `自動調整: なし`.

Snippet API: scene/reward files export `{ meta, render(ctx) }`; ctx = { L (scripts/lib.js instance), people ({sideFigure, backFigure}), theme (resolved palette {main,dark,tint,tint2,warm,glow}), parts ({table, vignette, beer} from rewards/_parts.js factory `(L)=>({...})`) } — same ctx object passed to scene and reward. Scene meta = {id, title, season:'晩秋', trail}; reward meta = {id, title}. Snippets do not require anything. Custom snippet paths are require()d (resolved relative to spec dir, absolute allowed); bare id must match /^[a-z0-9_-]+$/. Render order: resetDefs → scene.render → reward.render → layout.

Spec as implemented (matches plan.md schema): edition (編 appended), round int 1–99 default 1, area_romaji /^[A-Z0-9 .'&-]+$/ ≤24, date YYYY-MM-DD (real date), start H:MM (0–23), subtitle, theme id|object (all 6 keys #rrggbb), kcal int 1–9999 (numeric string accepted) wins over kcal_basis {mets>0, hours>0, activity?}, overview.date {value?,note?} (override must contain （曜）), overview.place/exercise/meal/items {value, note?}, notes 1–2 strings, caution bool, timeline 4–6 {time H:MM, label}, illustration {scene, reward, trail?}, organizer, contact, output_name (no / \ : and no leading dot). Keys starting with '_' stripped recursively (loadSpec). Normalized object fields: outputName, edition, edSize, roundLabel, vol, area, year, mmdd (zero-padded), startLine (`WKD  H:MM START`), subtitle, subSize, themeId (null for custom), pal, kcal (string), kcalInfo, rows[{key,label,value,note,size}], notes{lines,size}, caution, timeline[{time,lines,size}], scene, reward, scenePath, rewardPath, trail, footer, footerSize, derived{weekdayJa,weekdayEn,dateValue}, fits[].

Fit limits implemented exactly per plan.md: edition 62→40 lim 620; subtitle 19→15 lim 779; overview value 21→16 lim 680−(note? tw(note,14.5)+20 : 0), note >300 → exit 3; notes 15→12.5 lim 732 (712 caution), 2 strings share min size, 1 string: one line if fits else split into 2 with '　' prefix on line 2 (width included); exercise label 13.5→11.5 lim step−10 max 2 lines; meal label 15→12.5 lim 208 max 2 lines; footer 14→11 lim 280. Sizes step 0.5. fitWrap prefers wrapping at default size, then shrinks. '|' = forced breaks (no auto-wrap then). Text that fits at default is untouched.

Deviations / additions vs plan.md (none affect the 4 references): (1) a single short note renders as ONE line vertically centered at y=NY+30 (plan didn't specify). (2) Auto-wrap scoring = longest line width + per-break penalty×size: 0 after ・、。）／; 2 after particle で/に/を/は/が/へ/も/の before non-hiragana or kana→kanji/katakana; 3 after particle (not の) before hiragana; 4 other script changes; 6 kanji→hiragana; 8 same-script. NO_START also includes small kana っゃゅょぁぃぅぇぉッャュョァィゥェォ; never breaks between ASCII word chars. (3) tw('→')=1em (U+2192 ≥ U+2000) — same as old code. (4) Examples' kcal_basis shows mets as 8 / 6 / 5 (JSON drops .0) and include `_comment` and `_kcal` keys.
